major_concerns: Unclear formalization and provenance of the "safety-policy" verifier ruleset (coverage vs. real-world policies).
Emulator fidelity (Mininet vs vendor devices) may not detect semantic policy violations; risk of false negatives/positives.
Repair loop may introduce secondary unsafe constructs not covered by verifier.
Dataset sourcing and intent selection criteria are underspecified (possible selection bias).
Power/sample-size justification absent; multiple-comparison plan needs detail.
required_design_repairs: Specify deterministic verifier (e.g., Batfish) version, exact rule set, and how policies are encoded/validated.
Provide explicit emulator configuration, test-suite scripts, and mapping from verifier flags to emulator tests.
Define dataset sourcing, inclusion/exclusion rules, and a reproducible intent-sampling procedure; publish intent corpus or provide stable identifiers.
Pre-register exact prompt templates, repair prompting strategy, allowed model call budget, seeds, and retry policy.
Add power analysis/sample-size justification and pre-register subgroup analyses; include artifact-sharing plan for reproducibility.

major_concerns: Curated retrieval corpus construction (sources, licensing, coverage) is underspecified and may bias results.
Operational definition and automated detection of "factual contradiction" vs. acceptable alternative commands is underdeveloped.
Static CLI parser/emulator fidelity to real vendor CLIs must be justified.
Retrieval+RAG hyperparameters (k, reranker, embedding model) not fixed; results sensitive to these choices.
required_design_repairs: Document retrieval corpus sources, selection criteria, license status, and provide a reproducible build script or snapshot.
Define the factual-error annotation procedure (automated vs human adjudication) and inter-rater procedures if manual checks are used.
Specify CLI parser/emulator (version, vendor coverage) and validate it against a small ground-truth set of vendor commands.
Pre-register retriever and RAG hyperparameters (k, embedding model, scoring), prompt templates, and evaluation thresholds; include retrieval-rank logging for attribution analysis.

major_concerns: Single-model design limits external validity and makes it hard to generalize prompt-sensitivity findings.
Few-shot example selection and prompt-template corpus are underspecified and can strongly affect outcomes.
Potential carryover/context-window and ordering effects not fully mitigated by described randomization.
Multiple comparisons and interaction tests risk false discoveries without clear correction plan.
required_design_repairs: Pre-register all prompt templates, examples, and exact tokenization (including vendor-context tokens) and include selection rationale.
Either include at least one additional model family or clearly restrict claims to the tested model and state generalization limits.
Specify randomization/blocking scheme to avoid carryover and include context-window constraints; fix seeds and prompt-order logging.
Pre-register statistical correction plan for multiple comparisons (e.g., familywise alpha) and include power analysis for main effects and interactions.

major_concerns: Ethical risk of documenting poisoning/attack artifacts and potential dual-use; responsible-disclosure plan missing.
Poisoned-document construction and attribution method (linking safety violations to poisoned docs) are underspecified and may be non-reproducible.
Mitigation design (retriever-filter thresholds) is heuristic and needs principled calibration.
Sanitization of released artifacts to avoid enabling misuse is not described.
required_design_repairs: Add an explicit ethics and responsible-disclosure section; obtain an approvals/oversight statement and define redaction policy for public artifacts.
Pre-register automated poisoned-document generation rules, attack constraints, and a reproducible script for corpus poisoning.
Specify retrieval-filtering mitigation algorithm, thresholds, and how they were chosen (validation set) and log ranks/provenance for attribution.
Provide an artifact-release plan describing what will be published, what will be redacted, and how to reproduce experiments safely in emulator-only environments.
